title: ZenaTech Secures Energy-Sector Survey Contracts Representing Nearly C$1 Million in Project Work Through Its Drone as a Service Business
summary: ZenaTech Secures Energy-Sector Survey Contracts Representing Nearly C$1 Million in Project Work Through Its Drone as a Service Business New […]
body_markdown:
*New projects with an established Canadian oil and gas producer and a major energy infrastructure company include C$270,000 under contract, with approximately C$700,000 in anticipated follow-on work*


**Toronto, Ontario, November 17, 2026** — ZenaTech, Inc. (Nasdaq: ZENA) (FSE: 49Q) (BMV: ZENA) (“ZenaTech”), a technology solution provider specializing in AI (Artificial Intelligence) drone, Drone as a Service (DaaS), enterprise SaaS, and Quantum Computing solutions, announces that its Drone as a Service business has secured survey contracts with two established energy sector customers. Combined, the projects represent nearly C$1 million (approximately US$680,000) in work, including C$270,000 of work currently under contract and approximately C$700,000 of follow-on work expected upon successful execution of the current work. The projects support plant construction and infrastructure development for an established Canadian oil and gas producer and a large energy infrastructure company.


“These projects show the kind of repeat, relationship-driven work we are building in our Drone as a Service business. We have over C$270,000 under contract today and expect further work from the same customers if we execute well, which gives us better visibility into future revenue,” said Shaun Passley, Ph.D., ZenaTech CEO. “As we deepen our relationships with energy sector customers, many of whom serve large end clients on multi-year projects, we expect to build a scalable, recurring revenue base across our DaaS network and create long-term value for our shareholders.”


The first customer is an established Canadian oil and gas producer with which the DaaS business team has had a relationship for more than 10 years. The team is currently completing C$150,000 of contracted survey and environmental work related to infrastructure construction for a large project and, upon successful execution, expects approximately C$500,000 of additional work on the project over the next six months.


The second customer is a large energy infrastructure company. The DaaS team has secured C$120,000 of work for plant site inspection, including mapping and monitoring to support design and construction, and expects approximately C$200,000 of additional work on the project next year.


ZenaTech’s Drone as a Service network combines professional licensed surveying expertise with drone-based surveying and mapping to support energy infrastructure projects from initial planning through construction process and can extend to inspection work once the project is completed. For oil and gas producers, these services can include surveying pipeline routes, well sites and access roads, establishing boundaries and rights-of-way, and supplying terrain data for engineering design, environmental assessments and regulatory applications. For energy infrastructure operators, the network can support the construction and expansion of processing plants and related facilities through site mapping, precise construction layout, progress monitoring and as-built surveys documenting completed work. By pairing aerial data collection with centralized LiDAR data processing, an area where ZenaTech is developing proprietary AI software, this approach is designed to significantly speed both the field and office work of surveying over legacy methods, enabling construction projects to advance


ZenaTech’s Drone as a Service business is designed to provide business and government customers with subscription-based drone services using its own ZenaDrone product platforms, for a host of surveying, inspections, maintenance, power washing, and precision agriculture solutions, eliminating the need for customers to own, operate and maintain commercial-grade drone fleets. The Company currently operates almost 45 global DaaS locations in the U.S., Canada, U.K., Ireland, UAE and Australia.


The follow-on work described in this release reflects management’s current estimates and expectations for project planning purposes, based on the scope of the projects, discussions with the customers, and prior work history. There is no assurance that it will be awarded or completed in the time periods anticipated. Follow-on work may be reduced, delayed or cancelled due to various factors such as capital spending decisions, changes in project scope or schedule, commodity prices, regulatory and permitting approvals, weather and site conditions, and the successful execution of work currently underway. Contracted and anticipated amounts are not equivalent to recognized revenue. ZenaTech will provide updates on this work as future milestones are achieved.


US dollar equivalents are provided for the convenience of U.S. investors converted at US$1.00 = C$1.43 exchange rate and are subject to fluctuation.


**About ZenaTech**[ZenaTech](https://www.zenatech.com/) , Inc. (Nasdaq: ZENA) (FSE: 49Q) (BMV: ZENA) is a technology company that specializes in AI autonomy drone platforms to transform commercial, government, and defense sectors. Its subsidiaries include drone manufacturing through ZenaDrone, a global[Drone as a Service](https://www.droneasaservice.com/) (DaaS) business, and an enterprise SaaS division of software brands. The Company is executing an acquisition-led DaaS roll-up strategy to digitize and automate legacy service industries like land surveys and inspections, driving drone-based scalable, recurring revenue growth. With an operating footprint spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, Asia, and Australia, ZenaTech is advancing AI drones for applications such as agriculture and logistics, as well as ISR, cargo, and counter-UAS for U.S. defense and NATO allies. The company is investing in next-generation technologies, including drone swarms, quantum computing, and advanced AI autonomy to capture long-term opportunities in key markets through its R&D initiatives.


**About ZenaDrone** ZenaDrone, a subsidiary of ZenaTech, develops and manufactures AI-powered multifunction autonomous drone solutions integrating machine learning, predictive analytics, and advanced computing technologies, for government, defense, and industrial applications. This includes multifunctional drones for surveying, inspections, logistics, security, and defense applications. Its product portfolio under development includes the[ZenaDrone 1000](https://www.zenatech.com/drone-technology-solutions/) for ISR defense and specialized cargo, the[IQ Nano](https://www.zenatech.com/drone-technology-solutions/) for indoor inventory management and security, the[IQ Square](https://www.zenadrone.com/zenadrone-iq-square/) for outdoor inspections and maintenance, the[IQ Quad](https://www.zenadrone.com/iq-quad-drone/) for land surveying, the IQ Aqua, for underwater applications, and the IQ Octo for precision agriculture. ZenaDrone operates three global manufacturing facilities in Arizona, Dubai, and Taiwan, and is advancing counter-UAS maritime interceptor drones and an integrated defense system.
